From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>

Subject: Weekly forecast sweep — commit roundtrip & ops brief

Team — quick operational note for this week's forecast submission (please read end-to-end). We have the Friday submission window at 2:00pm PT; to make the numbers credible we need clean stage hygiene and a short roundtrip on any material commit changes. Action items below: 

- By Thursday EOD PT: update Deal Stage + Commit Type for any movement since last week. If you move a deal into Commit, add a 1-2 line "Commit reason" in the spreadsheet.
- If you move a deal back (or out of commit), add the primary blocker and next step.
- Flag any at-risk deals > $50k with an explicit risk tag and a proposed mitigation owner.
- Add close probability where it has changed >10 points.

I attached the Q4_commit_sheet.xlsx (master) and a short call agenda (forecast-call-agenda.md). Links: shared Drive folder and HubSpot ACME record are in the attachments/links.

Pre-call triage requests (please own if assigned):
- Acme Corp (Claire Park) — Marissa, can you confirm procurement milestone & DocuSign ETA? I marked the row and added a comment in the sheet.
- Engage win review: any forecasted wins that require finance sign-off, list them in the "needs-finance" tab.

Call details (Friday 10:00am PT, 30 minutes):
- 10:00 — 10:05 Quick numbers snapshot (Sofia)
- 10:05 — 10:20 Deal triage (owners call out 1-2 items each)
- 10:20 — 10:30 Confirm final submissions, note any escalations for tomorrow

If you're not the deal owner but have relevant context, drop a short note in the row. If you will miss the call, add your updates before 9:00am PT Friday so we can call them out.

Thanks — see you on Friday.

Sofia Ivanova
Revenue Operations (RevOps)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4_commit_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet), forecast-call-agenda.md (text), wins_dashboard_screenshot.png (PNG preview)
